text:
I don't hold a glirol, and I haven't found a recipe for one.

I spent about 55 of my 80 turns on it. Here is what I found:
- **Single items:** doudrur on its own makes glavruzael (2 per craft), and lugli on its own makes naeviozhum (3 per craft). I crafted both. Thegen and tepitil make nothing alone.
- **Combinations:** none of the pairs, triples or small grids I tried matched anything. That covered glavruzael, naeviozhum, thegen, tepitil and lugli in several positions.

I used up all three doudrur crafting glavruzael, so that route can't be repeated. I'm stopping here rather than spending the remaining turns on more guesses.
